timebox.note: Targeted reuse of preserved sources only; no public requests, reacquisition, whole-source survey, images or geocoding. Documentation packaging follows source review.

sourceSemantics.nativeLayerDescription: Point features typically located in the center or base line intersect point of a substation yard. Attributes provided by TRED Facility database table which is considered the source of record for facility operations information. Primary key relationship is based on the unique 4-letter XREF code value.
sourceSemantics.layerEditMeaning: Layer-level edit metadata, not a per-project progress date or a coordinate survey epoch.
limitations: Published point represents an existing substation yard center or baseline intersection; the source does not identify which of those two roles applies to this feature.
Name is labeled Approximate Location. Horizontal accuracy, survey method, coordinate epoch and equipment position are not supplied; decimal length is not accuracy.
Source service is Web Mercator (WKID 102100/latestWKID 3857); the preserved server query requests outSR=4326 and the response declares WKID 4326. No local transformation or geocoding was performed.
GERP map guide page 5 allows multiple projects at one data point. Bundle identity alone cannot turn a shared yard or nearby asset into the center of every associated scope.

Evidence snapshot was acquired on September 30, 2026; GIS layer edit time and feature status are not accepted project-progress dates. Existing plan lifecycle, milestone conflicts and owner unknowns remain unchanged.
